entities.summary: Nehemiah Mote is an Australian volleyball player. Nehemiah was offered an AIS scholarship in 2013 after a three-month trial, and represented NSW at the Australian Junior Volleyball Championships. He was selected to represent Australia for the first time in the Under 23's Junior World Championships in Brazil. He previously played for TV Bühl, VfB Friedrichshafen, and Berlin Recycling Volleys in Germany and Volley Amriswil in Switzerland. He returned to Berlin Recycling Volleys in 2021.
